children: MBG By Multibank Group plans to unlock about 24.47 million MBG in December 2026. The tokens scheduled for release equal 6.71% of the circulating supply.

The unlock removes the restriction that prevents holders from selling those tokens. The release itself does not place any sell orders. Once the tokens are unlocked, holders can decide how many to offer for sale and when.

title: MBG By Multibank Group: Unlocks About 24.47 Million MBG - Dec 2026
